label: M2.4-B blind human gameplay acceptance: preregistered protocol (human validation only; no training)

policies.A: accepted N4B1C runtime policy (FixedEscapePolicy, lateral_dual_path_v1), built by the unchanged Session
policies.B: frozen M2.4-A candidate seed_2/ckpt_it060 (state_dict a8f78d39..., numpy export parameter sha256 0692117a..., verified at load) in the unchanged ManeuverPolicy adapter, stochastic sampling seeded with world_seed + 104729

arena: ROOM (game_room_config.json), play mode, fullscreen, unchanged world / physics / lifecycle / brain / recorder

design.per_block: one A and one B session, same world seed, randomised order
design.order_rule: HMAC-SHA256(secret key, "block:<b>") first byte parity: even -> AB, odd -> BA
design.world_seed: 41,000,000 + 1000 x block (disjoint from all M2 TRAIN / EVAL seeds)
design.blinding: identity hidden during play; neural HUD disabled (its diagnostics differ by policy class); identity revealed only after the session ratings are saved; public manifest carries only sha256 commitments; the key is published only after all sessions

session.length: 180 s of active play (ticks with a live fly); pauses and post-splat time do not count; the session ends automatically
session.restart: R after a splat (unchanged game control); restarts continue the same session
session.completion_rule: an attempt with < 90 % of the active time (early quit or crash) is not counted; the same session (same policy and seed) is offered again; incomplete attempts are logged
session.no_early_stopping: all 30 sessions are completed; analysis refuses a partial set
session.no_tuning: neither policy is changed during or after the sessions

objective_metrics.committed_strike: swatter phase enters {commit, fast_swing, active_contact, follow_through, recovery} from outside
objective_metrics.hit / resolution: unchanged TickEvents.hit / strike_resolved while that strike is open
objective_metrics.successful_escape: resolved non-hit strike with a policy escape action between strike start and resolution
objective_metrics.escape_latency: strike start -> first escape action during the strike
objective_metrics.unnecessary_escape: escape action while no strike is committed and horizontal swatter distance > 310 units (benchmark v2 definition)
objective_metrics.wall_contact: rising edge of wall or object contact
objective_metrics.lifecycle_failures: airborne stalls (AIRBORNE / LAND_APPROACH below 5 % of cruise speed for >= 2 s) and perch bouts >= 60 s
objective_metrics.also_recorded: seed, duration, takeoffs, deaths, recorder session path

subjective_ratings.scale: 1-7, asked after each session before the identity is revealed
items: constant escaping for no reason (higher = worse)
subjective_ratings.extra: broken / stuck / exploitable (y / n); optional free-text note

analysis.pairing: block (A and B sessions with the same seed, adjacent)
analysis.objective: pooled per-strike rates with block-cluster bootstrap 95 % CI of B - A (20,000 resamples); session-level paired block differences with bootstrap CI and exact Wilcoxon signed-rank; order-aware: B - A by within-block order (AB vs BA) and a descriptive session-index trend
analysis.subjective: paired block differences per item (mean, median, bootstrap CI, Wilcoxon)
analysis.caveat: one player, 30 sessions: descriptive, low power; no claim beyond consistency with M2-EVAL-v3

acceptance.A_not_broken_or_exploitative: B sessions flagged broken / exploitable <= A flags + 2, median naturalness(B) >= 3, no B session with an infrastructure error
acceptance.B_no_major_twitchiness_or_pathology: paired mean (B - A) twitchiness <= +1.0 and needless-escaping <= +1.0; pooled unnecessary escapes / min (B) <= 5.36 or <= A; turning / saccade action fraction (B) <= A + 0.05; wall contacts / min (B) <= 1.5 x A + 0.5
acceptance.C_no_major_lifecycle_regression: perch events / min (B) >= 0.5 x A; lifecycle failures (B) <= A + 3
acceptance.D_objective_consistent_with_benchmark: pooled human hit probability per resolved committed strike (B) <= A (point estimate; CI reported, significance not required)
acceptance.E_experience_acceptable: A-D pass AND paired mean naturalness (B - A) >= -1.0 AND responsiveness (B - A) >= -1.0
acceptance.recommendation: GO for OPTIONAL runtime integration only if A-E all pass; otherwise NO-GO. Even on GO, the accepted default policy is NOT replaced; integration needs a separate explicit approval

privacy: per-session results, ratings, notes, recordings and the key stay under artifacts/m2_4_b/ (git-ignored) and are not committed unless the user explicitly asks
runtime_boundary: accepted runtime 363a1a9 unchanged; no merge; stop after the human-test report
